hook.name: AeroSlipstreamAggregator v1.1
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps from Aerodrome Slipstream concentrated liquidity pools (tokenized equities vs USDC), returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap.
